preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and stdin.isupper() and len(stdin) > 0 and len(stdin) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty uppercase string of length at most 10^6

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Kevin {}' if kevin_score > stuart_score else 'Stuart {}' if stuart_score > kevin_score else 'Draw'
postconditions.description: stdout is the winner's name and their score, or 'Draw' if scores are equal, where kevin_score and stuart_score are computed as follows: kevin_score is the total count of all substrings starting with vowels (A, E, I, O, U), and stuart_score is the total count of all substrings starting with consonants (all other uppercase letters)

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'AEIOU' or c not in 'AEIOU' for c in stdin)
postconditions.description: every character in stdin is either a vowel (A, E, I, O, U) or a consonant
